question: The ______ edition of the Rajasthan International Folk Festival was organized from 6th to 10th October 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**13th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Rajasthan International Folk Festival (RIFF)** is an annual music and arts festival held in **Jodhpur, Rajasthan**, India.
 
• The festival celebrates the traditional folk music and dance of Rajasthan and other parts of India, as well as international folk music.
 
• RIFF was **first organized in 2007** and has since become one of the most prominent folk festivals in India.
 
• The festival **usually takes place in October** and lasts for five days, featuring a variety of musical performances, workshops, and cultural events.
